quotes.text:
Avoid 1964,
Go for 
Iris, four54, eastcann, tribal.

Tribal and Iris are better then others.
Like people here recommending the 1964 comatose which is not as good as Iris but if you really want to try other brands give it a go, hardware is not good and its cured resin so terps are muted, high is mellow and tiring which I liked for night use.

all bangers i’d personally recommend!

I’ve smoked close to 100 carts from purple hills. 
Never had a clog or ghost toke. 
The ccell stainless post is aged, not ceramic but carries itself well. 
There are so many options of 510s out there. Many ppl have lost their shirts releasing a product without proper field testing. 
I took the safe approach and launched with a stainless ccell. 
The failure rate is less than 1%
If capped within…
